amendment.reason: Execution plumbing only. TASK-20261003-8613c9 was refused by tools/experiment_execution.py admission before any trial ran (release TASK-20261003-8613c9.1.release.json: 'handoff archive coverage missing: ... RUN-GRUMPY-9df12c/launch.json'). Two defects: (1) its committed artifact_paths omit the 16 supervisor-generated paths for RUN-GRUMPY-9df12c and RUN-GRUMPY-a8ec76; (2) its handoff.execution.trial_plan names trial-plan-v1.json while the standard plan path is trial-plan.json, so a launch via trial-plan.json fails the exact binding. The committed queue and handoff are immutable and the supervisor locates the task through this plan's own queue/task_id fields, so the additive repair is this successor plan naming a new disjoint single-task queue whose executor card TASK-20261004-0724d3 carries full coverage and an execution binding naming this file. No run directory exists for either run ID; both are retained.
